prior_attempts.failed_step: Verify initial acceptance planning and canonical transaction mechanics
prior_attempts.failure_stage: stale snapshot behind an ordinary writer changes buyer history at another seller
prior_attempts.diagnosis: The synthetic writer reused a timestamptz parameter as text, causing PostgreSQL to render payload timestamps in its session format. The strict normalized/payload reader correctly rejected the noncanonical timestamp before the intended buyer-active check.
prior_attempts.correction: Bind the canonical JSON payload separately from the SQL timestamptz parameter. Reproduced the conversion locally and verified corrected canonical reads through the actual participant; integrity guards are unchanged.
prior_attempts.retained_gates: All 1390 test cases, root TypeScript, offline demo and seven retained PostgreSQL drills passed; Chromium steps were skipped after the new native drill failed.

limitations: No production deployment, main merge, database migration/write, real provider, signer, key, chain call, user signup or live funds.
